name: Kalsubai Peak
tagline: The 'Everest of Maharashtra' — the state's highest point, iron ladders included
seoTitle: Kalsubai Peak Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Kalsubai, Maharashtra's highest peak — iron ladder sections, night-trek sunrise option, crowds, and safety.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — clouds and mist for atmosphere, but lower visibility and slicker ladders

seasons.label: Oct – Mar
seasons.sub: Clearer views, safer footing on the iron ladder sections

seasonNote: Sources split on 'best' season here: monsoon gives the most dramatic cloud experience, but winter is safer and gives clearer summit views. Prioritize whichever matters more to you — atmosphere or visibility/safety.

routeOptions.name: From Bari village
routeOptions.notes: The standard route, with iron ladders bolted to rock near the summit. Also popular as a night trek timed for sunrise.

safety.intro: Kalsubai is Maharashtra's most-visited peak trek, and its popularity is itself a factor — expect serious crowding on the iron ladder sections on weekends.

alerts.title: Iron ladder sections get crowded and slippery on weekends
alerts.body: The summit approach uses several iron ladder/step sections. On busy weekends these become bottlenecks — wet rock plus queueing crowds is a real slip risk. Go on a weekday if possible.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Decide on a day trek vs. night trek for sunrise — the night option needs a headlamp and warmer layers
Expect heavy crowds on weekends/holidays — plan patience into your timing

cards.title: On the trail
items: Use the iron ladders one at a time — don't rush past others queueing
Carry a headlamp even for day treks in case descent runs later than planned

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: One of the safest solo options given how heavily trafficked it is
If night-trekking for sunrise, stick close to other groups on the trail for safety and route-finding

items.name: Trekking shoes with good grip for the ladder sections
Warm layer if night-trekking for sunrise
Headlamp + spare batteries (essential for night treks)
